# list

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/list"
```

Package list is a cursor list with section headings, a scroll indicator or pages, a / filter that can rank fuzzily, and an optional title and status line. Rows carry a caller payload; what a choice means is the caller's.

<a name="Row"></a>
## type [Row](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/list/list.go#L29-L36>)

Row is one line, carrying a payload of the caller's type T. A Section row is a heading \(or a blank spacer when its Label is empty\) and cannot be selected. Mark is a glyph before the label; Style colours an unselected row, falling back to the theme's Dim. A Description shows muted under the label, and once one row has one every row takes two lines.

```go
type Row[T any] struct {
    Label       string
    Description string
    Section     bool
    Mark        string
    Style       *lipgloss.Style
    Value       T
}
```

<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/list/list.go#L94-L104>)

Styles are how a list paints its parts.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Title       lipgloss.Style
    Section     lipgloss.Style // a heading row
    Row         lipgloss.Style // a row off the cursor without a Style of its own
    Cursor      lipgloss.Style // the row under the cursor, and the filter prompt
    Description lipgloss.Style // the second line of a two-line row
    More        lipgloss.Style // the "↓ N more" row
    Status      lipgloss.Style
    Arrive      lipgloss.Style // its foreground is where a new row fades from
    Gone        lipgloss.Style // its foreground is where a removed row fades to
}
```

<a name="DefaultStyles"></a>
### func [DefaultStyles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/list/list.go#L109>)

```go
func DefaultStyles(th theme.Resolved) Styles
```

DefaultStyles draw the cursor row in the cursor role over dim rows, the title in bold accent and the new and removed rows fading through the accent and the border.
